description: A wire basket sits on the tabletop with a shiny metal tray on its left side, and a bunch of colorful plastic utensils are nearby. The right hand reaches into the basket’s left compartment to grasp the utensil bundle (right-hand object), lifts it out, then moves rightward and repeatedly releases individual pieces onto the table, spreading them into separate piles, while the left hand stays near the center and briefly nudges one utensil to line it up.
